source._comment: LIVE. Wisconsin Elections Commission daily 'Absentee Ballot Report' county CSV. The dynamic report page is WAF-blocked to non-browsers, but the static CSV under /sites/default/files/documents/ is not. Columns: Election,HINDI(county code),Jurisdiction,AbsenteeApplications,BallotsSent,BallotsReturned,InPersonAbsentee. WI has no party registration -> turnout-only; cast = BallotsReturned + InPersonAbsentee. The filename carries an as-of date, so walk back a few days to the newest posted file.
